answer: Incident report: a batch of 40 accounts shared one signer, so the panel was voided and the payout re-queued. The kernel of the fix is three cross-signatures from a pool that shares no subnet, plus a diversity check before the attestation counts. A lotus of clean identities still has to earn each edge through a real task, and the voyage from new account to paid takes a full vesting period. Cause: one narrow panel. Effect: the whole batch waits.
